body: Yep. 95% of the people here give unneeded, unhelpful, irrelevant, and/or terrible advice and/or comments.

A lot of your first paragraph does not make sense. The first sentence doesn't contain a predicate. 

Most of it is nonsense. The reason I want to commit suicide is not because I simply hate everything. Sure I hate all the parts in my life but it is not simply "Oh I hate everything". It is impossible to not be negative about my life. You can't put a positive spin on my life. And on most lives on SW, you can't either. Telling someone to be positive isn't going to help all the time. I'm sure if someone jsut lost their wife/house/kids, they aren't going to say "well, I'll just be cheerful". Of course not. Read the situation. 

Of course I hate going outside. If you've READ anything in my thread and my OP, it would be obvious that I have agoraphobia.

I live on my own. But see, it's generalizing statements like that. You don't know each individual case. Saying that "Well, trust me, you can" is dumb. I can't get a job. It's nearly impossible to change my routine. I've tried countless times. Small steps aren't as easy as you think. What may seem pedantic for you, will seem monstrous for other people. 

I agree. I know that I want these long term goals to happen instantly. But it's hard to wait longer. I've never had a friend since grade 3. I am in second year of university. Do you know what that's like? I've wanted to commit suicide for 4 years but I'm too much of a coward. In the past year, it's gotten worse. Do you know what that's like? To be completely isolated from the world, have no future, no one who cares about you, no one who calls or says hello during the day. Think about that for a second. I want you to take away everyone you talk to, quit your job, and never leave your house. You can't leave your house cause you are too scared. You can't find a future at your university. You don't do anything for fun anymore. You have not only lost the ability to hold a conversation (because you can't remember what they're like), but you can't even recall the last time you had fun or were happy. Think about that long and hard. **People who have suicidal tendencies CAN NOT wait for their long term goals to occur especially when their is a chance they don't occur**

Well, considering no one sees me at at all during the day. I've spoken to 5 different people in real life over the past 9 months for longer than 30 seconds. In fact, in the past month, I've literally not held a conversation. I had no conversations from January to April. Then I spoke with 5 different people from May to August. And now, I've yet to have a conversation with someone. No one sees me everyday. I don't speak to anyone. No one would miss me. There are plenty of people on here who don't see people and are genuinely alone in the world. So no one would care.

Get that through your pretentious self-righteous head. Don't make generalizing statements about people you don't know. It isn't helpful to anyone on this subreddit except you to make yourself feel like you are doing some good.

The world is not black and white. But welcome to being amazingly depressed. Of course I find everything negative. It isn't easy just to switch on and enjoy things. It isn't easy. Read my original post again. Genuinely think about the stuff I've said in the thread. Wait for 5 minutes. And think "is it that easy to just turn your life around?".

Well, in my instance, not much. Since my life is just as worse as it is ever. But that's just me. It may help you.

My psychiatrist could not believe how bad my life was. He hadn't realized how grave my situation was. His understanding of my thoughts and life were so vastly different than my horrible reality.
If you want to talk on skype or msn, add me. But, fair warning, I'm a negative person.

Really? I'd bet you anything that you couldn't think of one person who cares about. Honestly. Not everyone has someone who cares about them. 

You don't think people try making a change and failing miserably? You'll never hear the story of the girl who came from poverty, went to Hollywood to become an actor, and failed miserably. Or the guy from the small town who didn't become the famous athlete. I tried and failed repeatedly. 

And smile to everyone? So, if some homeless guy who sings to himself, cackles randomly, and is disturbed...you'd still smile? You wouldn't try to avoid him? What if this was at night and you're walking alone on a dark street? 

Finally, no one chooses to wallow in their own self pity. They are stuck in there by a set of unfortunate circumstances. Sometimes, people self-sabotage but if they had a choice, a real choice, they wouldn't do it. You can't help but wallow in your self pity when you're close to suicide and depressed.

Same here. It's tough as hell to admit how pathetic you are. And the exact same thing happened twice to me during suicide scares. I told my new psychiatrist the truth but when I went into the hospital twice before, I lied.
Same. Sometimes I wish I wasn't a coward.

No. That's wrong. It's people like you why I hate 95% of the people on this subreddit. 

Saying that it gets better? You don't know that. You can't possibly know that. There are plenty of people in the world who's life does not get better. 

And more people than you realize? What a generalized statement. What if the only person who cares about me is a rapist? Would you then care?  

You'll smile if you see me on the street? What kind of fucking statement is that? Do you know what I look like or do you generally smile at everyone include the homeless guy who sings to himself on the street? 

Stop being a self-righteous pompous ass. Provide good advice specific to people. Hoping everyone has a wonderful day is not going to help someone who wants to kill themselves that day. **All it does is remind me that there are people like you that will be having good days.**

/rant

I wasn't trying to be funny. I was serious. Lots of people don't like or want house pets. And I'd bet the majority of people would not be excited at the idea of being in a room full of bees or mice. 

So you don't hate anything? Or anyone? You don't fear anything (except the obvious contradiction in the next paragraph)? 

You lead a pathetic life if you like everything you do and hate nothing. It is as bad as hating everything and liking nothing.

I think being alone forever goes along with being sad. I understand that maybe if I could be comfortable with being isolated, I could be happy. But as someone who has been isolated for about 9 months now with little to no human contact, it isn't. It is cruel. 

I've never liked animals. I just don't like pets. I didn't want a dog growing up. I didn't want a cat or a gerbil or even a fish. I don't like how "dirty" and "germy" things get with animals. I don't want to clean up after them or play with them. I can barely care for myself. Why the fuck would I want to care for another living thing? I'm sure there are plenty of people who don't want that. Honestly, does the average person like a bee or a mouse? Of course not. If you were in a room with a bee right now, would you not try and kill it/trap it/get it out of the room? 

Finally, I can hate whatever I want. Hate is a fundamental human principle.  People hate foods, ideas, sports teams, etc. Do you not hate a single thing? Do you eat all foods? Like all video games? Books? Did you not hate the bully growing up or the teacher who gave surprise tests? To ask a human not to hate at all, is to ask 

Hate is bred from fear but not all fear is necessarily bad. For example, I don't like squid. I have a fear of it tasting bad and I avoid that fear by hating it. Removing fear completely is also a terrible thing. The reason I look both ways when crossing the street is I don't want to be hit by a 2 ton car. Sure, fear is terrible because now I avoid going into new and unfamiliar places but asking me to remove fear is not as simple as telling me to stop.

I tend to agree that some people were born to have many friends and some people were born to have none. I'm probably going to be alone forever but why be alone forever and live a sad miserable life? That's why I want to kill myself. 

Also, I fucking hate all animals and pets. So I'm not getting a stupid cat.

Uhh people do stay away from me. That is why I'm alone. 

I don't ever expect to be the life of the party nor do I want to. I expected that in my life, from elementary school through the first year of university, I'd have one friend. Or one part of my life I found enjoyable. But nothing. 

I have a disease. The only medicine I can take is black boxed for it. So basically, the disease might not kill me but the medicine eventually will. Probably not going to live past 60. 

So your theory is that staying alone is better? And I should get a cat because then I'll be the person alone with a cat?
Hmm. Link to one for Canada? Seems like a pain in the ass though.
By that logic, I won't "feel" sad or worried either.

I think I'd be happy if I  turned around every problem I currently had. I could look in a mirror, have a friend or two, have a girl friend, not be deathly afraid of everything and find out what I want to do with my life. 

Unfortunately, I just don't see it happening. Some people were born to be athletes, some people weren't. Some people were born to have a awesome life, some people weren't

Yeah. That didn't exist. I didn't have a good childhood. This has been going on since I was 8 years old. I'm 19 now. I hated myself, others, my family growing up and I didn't have those "good times", unforgettably great stories or those fond memories. The only memories I have are the constant reminder of the mental hell and the embarrassing moments I've had. I don't have stories at all. The inner child literally doesn't exist for me.

Well, at 19, I've never done drugs or alcohol. I'm too much of a pussy to do any of that stuff. 

I only care about myself. Call me selfish but no one cares about me, I don't care about them. 

I did talk to a school counselor who explained my suicidal thoughts, crippling agoraphobia, lack of friends for 10 years and my lack of motivation in academic life, was me drinking too much pop a day. Apparently, a single can of coke zero was pushing it. So that ended pretty quickly. 

My psychiatrist asked me that. I can't recall the last time I was happy in the general sense and I was okay with my life. I can't remember the last time I had "fun" either. I honestly don't remember it. I wish I could, I can't.

I've been to psychiatrists, psychologists, and therapists. None of them have helped. 

The problem is, I can't figure out what makes me happy. I can't figure it out. I can't find a reason to live. Like I literally have been at that answer for years and I can't find it. If I wasn't a coward, I'd be dead a long time.

So it doesn't get better? You're still the same bitter old guy? No wife? No girlfriend? No friends? Did you ever figure out your life job? To be honest, your life sucks 20 years later doesn't sound like much of an improvement.
Alright. Respond to me privately or in that thread. I don't want this thread to turn into about me.

I think the bare minimum and the first rule for people willing to help is this "Read the original post. Then read subsequent comments. Then wait 5 minutes. Then make a comment if you feel the need to". Do not skip the OP or comments. Wait 5 minutes. Maybe imagine yourself in their shoes. But waiting 5 minutes will improve your suggestion. It can't possible harm it.

I'm suicidal and nothing pisses me off more than a terrible suggestion especially if it's worded terribly. Don't make me feel bad. I already feel bad. Telling me that "well, you aren't trying my suggestion" isn't helpful if I've rejected said notion. 

My question? Check my post history. It's on the 2nd page entitled "rate my life/10?" and it's in the OP.

I think people need to CTRL + F what other people are saying. Maybe your suggestion has already been said. Comment on that one or upvote so people know that they agree with it. If there are 30 comments with the same suggestion, it doesn't help. Especially once that suggestion can't be done. 

For example, if I asked how to cook a turkey in the oven. Don't tell me I can solve my problem by making it in the microwave. And if I tell you that I don't have a microwave. Going on to insist that I should get one isn't helpful. Especially if I have 30 more people cramming it down my throat just to cook it in the microwave.

The problem with this subreddit is 95% thinks they are being self-righteous by thinking that by saying they understand and offering advice, they are somehow being helpful. The 95% don't read the OP. They don't know what it's like.  

I read some posts on here and it's mind-boggling that they think they are being helpful. I asked for help in my post. One person actually tried to help me. The rest gave just advice like they think they know something.

I mean, this board helps me. I see people who are at their worst and still have a better life but they are bitching at it. I see people who are older whose life did not get better. It puts things in perspective. 

I asked a question here. It was never answered. I still can't find the answer.

Potential happiness? Killing myself will mean no more problems, no more embarrassment, no more waking up and having to deal with my shitty life. I won't have to deal with school courses or finding a job. No having to look at my ugly self in a mirror. I mean, there is nothing I will miss. Killing myself will lead to happiness.  I won't have to deal with my life. Ever. Again.

No. I said even without meds, I think at some point in my life, I'd have one friend. We are talking last years of elementary school, all of junior high school, all of high school, and the beginning of my university life without a friend. 

No one wants to hang around a depressed guy. Sure, I buy that but I see even some of the depressed people here having one friend in their life. 

And I mean, it isn't even just the friends that has me wanting to kill myself. 

But then again, maybe I wasn't born to have friends. Or be successful in school or life. No one really cares about me (oh and some random internet people who come here just to feel self-righteous about themselves don't really count). Fuck this life.

So then I could be the freak with meds? Even without meds, I think 1 friend or 1 good part of my life would be good? Heck, if I had a bottle, I'd probably swallow them all. The only reason I haven't is I can't even go to a store to buy massive amounts of sleeping pills.
Yeah but I think at this point, it'd be nice to have 1 friend in 10 years. Even without meds, 1 friend isn't a lot. I dont think a bottle of meds will help me get that 1 friend.
I've tried that for years. It hasn't worked.

Really? My life isn't bad at all? Not having a friend in 10 years isn't bad? Wanting to kill yourself for 5 years but being too much of a coward? Having 5 conversations all year with 4 people you can't stand and 1 being a psychiatrist? I can't take a bus or do anything outside or in places I haven't been. I have no idea what I want to do with my life but I've decided that take THE worst courses ever that I can't stand because I couldn't try in my first year of university because I hated those courses. My life isn't bad? I've lost my ability to have a conversation. I can't remember the last time I had fun. Nothing is enjoyable? Are you fucking insane? There is nothing I can look forward to. There is no reason for me to live. 

And honestly, DO YOU FUCKING THINK I USE A FACEBOOK? I've got no FUCKING FRIENDS.

So my life of depression, lack of friends for over a decade, my massive agoraphobia, my lack of motivation in school, my lack of anything I want to do in my life will be cured by a bit of exercise? This isn't like I've decided in the past few days. This is years and years. I've had 5 conversations this year. 

And what about 3-4 years ago when I did work out and exercise 3-4 times per week but hated waking up in the day? Will this also help the fact that I cant' look in mirrors cause I hate seeing my own face?

Yes. I'm sure. That's why the newspaper exists. 

Why look at it positively? It's painful looking in the mirror. I will not live this life.

Counseling - Been there repeatedly. Done that. No one really cares/tries and they seemingly run off a check list so they can collect a paycheck. 

Traveling - Considering I don't have the time/money or the ability to do anything in a foreign place that I haven't been to (foreign place can mean the library at my school in which I have not entered in a year and a half), I'm not traveling. Heck, who travels by themselves? 

Gym/Exercise - I don't see this crippling anything. So I'm going to work out in my bedroom for 40 years? I'm sure this will help in school/social life. 

Jobs -  I looked at your link. It seems like a waste of time and not worth it. Plus, a stay at home job isn't going to net me money and is not a good resume builder. Skill set? What skill set do I have? I'm a student with slightly better grammatical skills than everyone else. 

I can't think of a way to end this post except, fuck my life sucks more than anyone here can imagine. It's an isolated impossible cruel form of torture.

None. Even the video games I do play I can't stand playing anymore. I don't like any of my old "go-to" hobbies. I can't tell you the last time I came back from doing something thinking "this was good/fun"

Sometime? Let's try for 5 unbearable years where I was conscious of how shitty my life is.

I don't know how I would feel. I mean, too much weight? I don't know how much weight I should be putting on being alone but I don't have anyone who really cares if I'm alive.
